exposure: Infants with mothers born outside the UK
Infants with mothers born in the UK
cohort: 2493 children in Bradford, UK, recruited from pregnancy to 24 months of age between 2007 and 2013
finding: Socioeconomic status and Pakistani ethnicity were associated with increased amoxicillin prescribing for respiratory tract infections during the first two years of life.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with increased odds of amoxicillin prescribing during year 2 of life.
